note: The same story in non-native phrasing: phrasing is never a reason to flag.
lines: Hi, thanks for joining. Tell me a little about your current role.
Um, I am Bea Garcia, I am working as backend engineer in payments team since four years.
What does your team own day to day?
Uh, mostly we are handling the ledger and payouts service, also the, um, reconciliation jobs.
How do you usually ship changes?
We are doing small pull requests with flags, and rollout is taking one day more or less.
Normally two persons, one of them is from the team who is owning it.
Tell me about a time a cache caused you trouble, and what you did.
Yes, so last year our payouts page was showing old balance, because we are caching the balance five minutes and nobody is remembering this when we add the instant transfers.
I find it from a support ticket, honestly, and the fix is to evict the balance key in every ledger write. After I add one test so it cannot come back, and we make the time to live shorter.
Thanks. What would you like to ask me?
How does the team share on-call?
